name: Hono Luau Cube Off 2022

venue.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Alana Waikiki Beach
venue.address: 1956 Ala Moana Boulevard, Honolulu, Hawaii, 96815 USA

information: * There is a spectator fee. You may pay that through the donations when you register or at the door with cash or through PayPal. * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?app=desktop&v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 9:00 AM.
